description: resize() keeps the oldest entries and discards the newest, inverting the LRU guarantee
productionImpact: When shrinking the cache, the most-recently-used entries are evicted and the least-recently-used entries are retained, inverting the LRU guarantee. Applications that resize on memory pressure will find their cache populated with cold, idle data while hot keys must be re-fetched from the backing store, increasing latency and downstream load.
